project: Wuxia Life P127 Martial Second Visible Growth Sample
description: Single-sample follow-up to P122: extend early visible growth proof from merchant_house to one second sample only, using martial_family plus trainingHabit on existing summary, feedback, settlement, and continuation surfaces. No scholar parallel work, no new growth system, no combat-system rewrite.

userStories.title: Lock martial_family sample scope and anti-expansion boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the second visible-growth sample fixed to martial_family before any implementation planning, so the stage does not sprawl into scholar, poor, or generic template work.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix sample origin to martial_family only; no scholar_house or poor_family parallel work (PRD §4 Out of Scope, §12 Non-Goals)
Fix shaping axis to trainingHabit only; no multi-axis extension in this stage
Primary sample band is ages 5-8; light continuation proof band is ages 8-16 (PRD §4, §8)
Primary action is action_childhood_training; action_childhood_yard_play may be referenced as lighter prelude only, not a second main chain
Continuation targets are limited to p9_echo_training_hook, p9_early_training_focus, p22_early_martial_route_fork, and p42_training_habit_youth_sparring
Do not add new growth containers, panels, route families, or template abstractions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Scope lock first. This story exists to stop the common failure mode: turning P127 into scholar+martial batch work.

userStories.title: Show trainingHabit shaping confirmation on existing summary surfaces
userStories.description: As a player, I want the main screen to clearly show that repeated early training is shaping me, so martial childhood feels like growth instead of passive replay.
acceptanceCriteria: On the martial_family 5-8 sample path, shapingSummary transitions from 塑形未成 to an explicit martial shaping phrase when trainingHabit threshold is met (PRD §6 Signal A, US-001)
Confirmation text comes from existing trainingHabit/lifeStates wiring, not a new parallel growth system
Copy expresses growth direction rather than repeating origin flavor such as 你出身武学世家
Player can clearly read that a martial/习武 direction is forming
Reuse existing MainScreenLifeSummary / shapingSummary surfaces only; no new UI panel
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Equivalent to P122 summary-surface proof, but for trainingHabit.

userStories.title: Show long-term impact after early martial actions
userStories.description: As a player, I want early training actions to leave visible long-term traces in the feedback area, so I can connect my behavior to my martial shaping.
acceptanceCriteria: After sample early martial actions, feedback area shows at least one player-visible long-term impact confirmation (PRD §6 Signal C, US-003)
Confirmation reads as this will continue to affect my life direction, not only martial stat deltas
Reuse existing long-term impact / flag display mechanism; no new feedback framework
Does not open a new branch at this step; causal visibility only
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep this strictly player-visible and narrow.

userStories.title: Add period settlement martial shaping summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want age progression to tell me what martial shaping line became clearer this period, so each age step feels like meaningful growth rather than just bigger combat numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one age progression / period settlement on the martial_family sample path summarizes shaping change via existing periodSummaryDisplay (PRD §6 Signal B, US-002)
Settlement copy answers what kind of martial person you are becoming this period, not only generic narrative or stat fragments
Summary correlates with prior training behavior, not passive age-based growth
Reuse the existing settlement surface; do not add an independent settlement system
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Settlement confirmation is required; otherwise the slice stays event-local and does not feel like a life-stage change.

userStories.title: Prove p22 and p42 continuation readability on the martial sample
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one narrow proof that visible martial shaping makes later continuation easier to read, so P127 demonstrates reuse beyond the first confirmation moment.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce bounded proof for martial_family ages 5-16 only
Evidence shows behavior -> trainingHabit accumulation -> visible confirmation -> p22_early_martial_route_fork and/or p42_training_habit_youth_sparring becoming more readable as continuation
At least two different player-visible confirmation signals are present across summary / feedback / settlement surfaces
Do not expand sect route content, orthodox route content, or broader martial adolescence content in this stage
Save proof as docs/test-reports/p127-martial-second-visible-growth-sample-proof.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the real stage goal: prove that P122 is reusable, not merchant-only.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage for the second visible-growth sample
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow automated tests guarding the martial second-sample loop so future edits do not silently revert the player-facing confirmation pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update a narrow test file covering the martial_family second-sample visible-growth loop
Cover shapingSummary confirmation on the martial sample path
Cover long-term impact visibility after early training actions
Cover periodSummaryDisplay shaping summary tied to training behavior
Cover at least one continuation-readability check for p22_early_martial_route_fork or p42_training_habit_youth_sparring
Include scope guards: martial_family only, no scholar parallel work, no new growth system
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Reuse the narrow test style from P122. Do not build a generic cross-origin framework.
